title: Measures to Minimise Noise in Residential Areas near Seletar Airport
what_it_is: Measures to Minimise Noise in Residential Areas near Seletar Airport

sections.label: Seletar Airport aircraft noise measures
sections.summary: CAAS routes aircraft away from residential areas when wind permits and requires overflying aircraft to fly at least 450 metres.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In the case of Seletar Airport, arriving and departing aircraft will sometimes fly over nearby residential estates because of the wind conditions around Seletar Airport.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) is mindful of the noise pollution caused by overflying aircraft and has several measures to reduce it.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: First, whenever wind conditions permit, CAAS proactively routes the aircraft away from the residential areas.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Second, CAAS requires aircraft that overfly residential estates, such as those to the south and west of Seletar Airport, to operate at a height of at least 450 metres or 1,500 feet.

sections.label: Seletar night flight restrictions
sections.summary: CAAS prohibits training and freighter flights from 10.00 pm to 7.00 am at Seletar and allows only newer, quieter aircraft in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Third, CAAS prohibits training and freighter flights between 10.00 pm and 7.00 am at Seletar Airport, and allows only newer and quieter aircraft to operate within Singapore.

sections.label: Night permitted aircraft at Seletar
sections.summary: Flights permitted from 10.00 pm to 7.00 am are usually smaller aircraft with newer engines, including medical evacuation flights.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: The flights that are permitted from 10.00 pm to 7.00 am are aircraft that are usually smaller and with newer engines, and these can include medical evacuation flights into Seletar Airport.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: So, we limit this window to smaller, quieter aircraft, and the big aircraft with noisier engines are only limited to day time.

sections.label: Flight timings at military airports
sections.summary: Different timings apply to different military airports, whether Paya Lebar or Tengah.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Does this flight time also apply to other vicinities, such as near Paya Lebar Airbase in Hougang and Aljunied?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: It applies with different timings to different military airports, whether it is Paya Lebar or Tengah.
